title: Helper function
prompt: Write a second function called `cube(n)` that returns n × n × n. Then make solve(n) call cube(n) and return whatever it gives back. Both functions go in the same code box — put cube above or below solve.
hint: A function is defined with `func cube(n: int) -> int:` on its own line, followed by an indented body. Call it like `cube(n)`.
